player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely concluded the exploration with "DONE" while in the Living room, failing to check if all reachable directions from the current node and previously visited nodes had been fully explored. Specifically, upon returning to the Living room, I had available directions "west" and "east". I had previously visited "west" (leading to Pantry) and "east" (leading to Utility room), but I failed to verify if the Utility room had unexplored exits or if the Pantry had unexplored exits that I hadn't revisited. My mistake was assuming the map was complete based on the number of unique nodes visited rather than ensuring every edge from every visited node had been traversed. Next time, I will maintain a strict checklist of "unexplored exits" for every room I enter. Before issuing "DONE", I will verify that for every room in my `nodes` list, all directions listed as available in that room's history have been traversed. If I am in a room with available directions, I must traverse them unless I have a confirmed record of having visited the destination via that specific direction previously. I will only stop when I am in a room with no available directions, or when I have confirmed that all available directions from all visited rooms lead to already visited rooms and have been traversed.
